name: Org-28611
summary: Org 28611 (SCH-900,111) is a drug developed by Organon International which acts as a potent cannabinoid receptor full agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors.

pharmacology.text: Org 28611 (SCH-900,111) is a drug developed by Organon International which acts as a potent cannabinoid receptor full agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors.

uses.text: Org 28611 (SCH-900,111) is a drug developed by Organon International which acts as a potent cannabinoid receptor full agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, severe anxiety, paranoia and psychosis, and have been linked to seizures, kidney injury and deaths. They are often far stronger than cannabis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的合成大麻素類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、嚴重焦慮、妄想與精神病症狀，並與癲癇發作、腎損傷和死亡有關。這類藥物往往比大麻強得多。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的合成大麻素类药物，可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、严重焦虑、妄想与精神病症状，并与癫痫发作、肾损伤和死亡有关。这类药物往往比大麻强得多。

fact.en: It was made at Organon as a water-soluble cannabinoid, and such compounds were of interest partly because an injectable cannabinoid is far easier to study in hospital trials.
fact.zh: 它由歐加農公司合成為水溶性大麻素。這類化合物之所以受到關注，部分原因是可注射的大麻素在醫院試驗中研究起來容易得多。
fact.zhHans: 它由欧加农公司合成为水溶性大麻素。这类化合物之所以受到关注，部分原因是可注射的大麻素在医院试验中研究起来容易得多。
